prose: Jim Gale is the incredibly vibrant and positive founder of Food Forest Abundance. We discuss Jim's vision for this company and the possibility of "saving the world" by turning yards into food! We also talk about taking visualization practices to the next level, and watching life in the external fractal expand as we take more responsibility for our life force energy within.
ext: We talk about enlightened selfishness, regenerative capitalism, the 12 Permaculture Principles, cryptocurrency, the controlled demolition of the current economy, and much more.
